name: Police officer, 2002 (generic)
depiction: Generic uniformed police officer in a plain dark-blue uniform shirt and trousers and a dark peaked cap, carrying a flashlight. No badge number, patch, shoulder flash, name tag, crest or insignia of any real force or agency is drawn, and no weapon is shown. Stands in for the officers who checked trucks, worked the Alabama scene and made the rest-stop arrest; not a likeness of any real officer.
